faq.headline: Quick answers.
faq.sub: What you’ll want to know before we start: timing, pricing, and how we work together.

note.title: Another question?
note.body: Message me on WhatsApp and I’ll answer.

items.question: What do you need from me to get started?
items.answer: An idea of the project’s goal and who the users are, plus anything you already have: a brand, an old design, or sites and apps you like. If the idea isn’t clear yet, we’ll shape it together in the first session.

items.question: How long does a project take?
items.answer: It depends on the scope: the number of pages or screens, and whether it needs to be built in code or just designed. Once we’ve talked through the details, I’ll give you a clear, phased timeline so you know what you’ll get and when.

items.question: How is pricing decided?
items.answer: Pricing is set once I understand the project: its size, what it needs to do, and whether it includes the build. You get a clear proposal listing everything included before we start, so there are no surprises later.

items.question: What are the stages, and can I follow along?
items.answer: We start by understanding the project and its users, then I show you several design directions to choose from, then I complete and deliver the designs. You see the work and give feedback at every stage, so the result turns out the way you want.

items.question: What if I don’t like the design, can we change it?
items.answer: Of course. Revisions are part of the work, which is why I show several directions at the start so we agree on taste before going into detail. We agree on how revisions work from day one, so everything is clear.

items.question: What do I receive at the end?
items.answer: Depending on what we agree: organised Figma files with a design system and prototype, ready for developers, or a finished website built in code and live. And I stay with you after handover if you need anything.

items.question: Do you work with companies outside Baghdad or Iraq?
items.answer: Yes. I work on-site in Baghdad or remotely with anyone, anywhere. Meetings are online, and delivery and follow-up run smoothly.
